headline: Abhishek Gilara submits SEBI takeover exemption disclosure to NSE
hook: Exemption claimed under SEBI takeover rules
summary: Abhishek Gilara has filed a regulatory disclosure under Regulation 10(6) of SEBI Takeover Regulations with the exchange. The filing details an acquisition made using an exemption provided under Regulation 10. Such disclosures are routine reporting requirements for stock transactions under specific exemptions.
